Article 4 (Faithful Performance of Duties)
(1) Judges shall faithfully perform their assigned duties and make continuous efforts to improve their professional competence.
(2) Judges shall conduct proceedings promptly and efficiently and carefully and thoroughly examine cases to ensure that trials are properly conducted.
(3) Judges shall treat parties, their representatives, and other persons involved in litigation kindly and courteously.
(4) Except where necessary for judicial proceedings, judges shall not meet or contact parties, their representatives, or other persons involved in litigation outside the courtroom.
(5) Except for educational or academic purposes or for the purpose of accurate reporting, judges shall not publicly comment on or express opinions about specific cases.
